scenario: Committed executable sources match revision. Executable-source SHA-256 30bb2e342f88402b6243f5497cef5ec85fa45c552c7ba2734e1283008e138eba. Real delayed loopback transport, immediate Moxi camera, retained reductions, capped exact selection and isolated lifecycle recovery
backend: Mojo App[Density] → experimental Wasm64 → Moxi SVG / MoxiWebHost; loopback Python transport
fixture: probe.generate_points(1_000_000, seed=0x5EED2026), immutable binary source SHA-256 cbc893afb24c38048ff9e30813c114c47ee1052bd18aa8963008ff93a04c991f
reproduce: See experiments/server-backed-views/README.md. MOXI_PIXI_MANIFEST=/path/to/installed/moxi/pixi.toml bash experiments/server-backed-views/build.sh; python3 experiments/server-backed-views/server.py --port 8766; MOXI_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/tmp/moxi-p01-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs node experiments/server-backed-views/browser-check.mjs; python3 scripts/demo_slideshows.py

slides.caption: initial grid
slides.action: Open the built P02 application; wait for both million-point reductions.
slides.expected: Two actual Moxi views each show a 32×32 grid totaling one million points.

slides.caption: pan pending retained
slides.action: Set 3000ms delay; drag A by 72×30 pixels in eight moves. Capture before the final reply.
slides.expected: The old grid moves synchronously with the Moxi camera; pending status is visible and B stays fixed.

slides.caption: fresh reduction
slides.action: Release the pointer and wait for the current-generation response.
slides.expected: Fresh viewport reduction replaces the transformed retained grid; one active and one replaceable pending were the maximum.

slides.caption: aggregate selection
slides.action: Click a visible density cell in A.
slides.expected: Orange aggregate bounds are selected; aggregate counts are not record IDs; exact selection is empty.

slides.caption: capped exact records
slides.action: Click Exact records (≤32) and wait for the separate capped request.
slides.expected: 32 stable source IDs and coordinates are shown, with the larger aggregate total and truncation disclosed.

slides.caption: network disconnected
slides.action: Use Chromium network-offline emulation and drag A.
slides.expected: The fetch fails visibly; the prior reduction and exact selection remain; B is isolated.

slides.caption: retry recovered
slides.action: Restore the loopback network and click Reconnect / retry.
slides.expected: The current viewport receives fresh data; exact IDs for the unchanged revision remain selected.

slides.caption: disposed while pending
slides.action: Pan A with 3000ms delay, then Dispose before the reply.
slides.expected: A has no live Moxi owner; B continues displaying its independent view.

slides.caption: restarted two views
slides.action: Restart A; wait for its new session and reduction.
slides.expected: A starts at the full viewport with empty selection and a new handle; B remains unchanged.
